meta.title: One bid: award all 10 units to Vendor A; approver approves without a remark
gaps: Sign in as the separate approver, approve the submitted proposal with the remark empty, and verify the exact refusal "Remark is necessary for approval" while the proposal remains pending.

plan.title: SRC-AWD-003 — Award and approval remark validation

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Verify the single real vendor column is Vendor A.
Verify Vendor A's offered quantity from the prepared event.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate from the prepared event.
Verify the displayed line amount and total use rate multiplied by quantity.
Open the awarding screen for the closed bid.
Allocate the line to Vendor A; the prepared event has one line and one vendor, so this allocates the complete line.
Assert that all line items and one vendor are selected.
Create the award proposal after allocation.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the completed award proposal for approval.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted proposal with the approval remark left empty, then verify the refusal and that the proposal remains pending

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to the separate approver identity or perform this negative approval check.
